assessments.reasoning: In both questionnaires, question f.1 explicitly instructs to exclude household tasks ("Sin considerar los quehaceres del hogar") when determining whether a person worked during the reference week. Unpaid domestic and care work is therefore explicitly excluded from the category of work/employment.
